newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CARLING AND GUSCOTT RECALLED TO ENGLAND SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CARLING AND GUSCOTT RECALLED TO ENGLAND SQUAD.

text.p: Former England captain Will Carling and his international centre partner Jeremy Guscott were recalled to the England training squad on Monday.
Neither player was selected in the original squad and there is still no room for the experienced Leicester pair Dean Richards and Rory Underwood.
Carling, who resigned as England captain last season, has been in impressive form for Harlequins this season and as an unexpected bonus has kicked 45 points in four matches.
"I am very pleased to be back in the squad," he said. "I have trained hard both before the start of the season and this month and I believe that I have generally played well in the games so far."

Both of England's first two training sessions were cancelled because of a dispute between the English Professional Rugby Union Clubs (ERPUC), who comprise the English league's top two divisions, and the Rugby Football Union.
However, Wednesday's session looks set to ago ahead after a statement from the ERPUC on Monday saying it would release its players.
